description: The strict composite \(h(g_0(\bar x),\ldots,g_{m-1}(\bar x))\) has output \(b\) exactly when there is a tuple \(\bar a\in\mathbb N^m\) of defined inner outputs with \(h(\bar a)\) defined and equal to \(b\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.strictComp_spec {m n : ℕ}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction m)
  (g : Fin m → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction n)
  (x : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n) (b : ℕ) :
  b ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.strictComp h g x ↔
    ∃ a, (∀ (i : Fin m), List.Vector.get a i ∈ g i x) ∧ b ∈ h a
